Review: Spotify is an absolute joke of a platform when it comes to basic user control and content safety. Meanwhile, their clunky interface traps you in foreign language glitches with no easy way out, and they refuse to implement a basic "Block Creator" feature for podcasts. Spotify completely fails its users by forcing unwanted media down your throat with zero accountability. The moment any similar app shows up on the market, I will leave Spotify at the speed of light. Avoid this garbage platform if you actually want control over what you and your family watch or listen to.
